page: Microsoft Azure NC40ads_H100_v5 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine powered by an AMD EPYC 9V84 processor. It features 40 dedicated physical cores (40 vCPUs) running at 3.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, with 320 GB of system memory (8 GB per core). The server is equipped with a single NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPU containing 94 GB of VRAM, alongside 3971 GB of local storage.

Benchmark results place the CPU performance in the top tier (top 10%) for single-core stress-ng tests and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Multi-core Geekbench and Passmark memory scores also rank in the top 10%. Large-block memory bandwidth read and write speeds fall within the top 25%, while LLM inference text generation speeds are strong (top 25%) for small (135M) and medium (7B) models, and average (middle 50%) for large (70B) models.

Given the integration of a high-end NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPU and dedicated AMD EPYC cores, this server offers high resource density for specialized workloads. The hardware profile is optimized for GPU-accelerated tasks such as machine learning training, large language model inference, ray tracing, and intensive database operations. The inclusion of nearly 4 TB of local storage supports data-heavy pipelines without requiring external storage overhead.
